text:
eva_ml: kicked off a small 'pulse' bench across regions for L4 / T4 / A10G — embeddings + small-chat. goal: latency tail, cost per 1k emb vectors, and sizing guidance for 100-500 rps. filing quick notes here.

alex: nice. what configs did you run? batch sizes, quant?

eva_ml: short summary:
- models: open-embed-512 (emb), chat-small-v1 (chat)
- quant: fp16 baseline, 4-bit q8/model quant for L4/T4 experiments (PEFT disabled)
- kernels: default fused, plus flash-attn test on A10G where available
- regions: us-west, eu-west, ap-south
- runtime: single-GPU instances, warm KV cache for chat warm-prefix tests

marta: can you paste the 99th/95th latency rows? those matter for SLAs.

eva_ml: sure, pulled from bench-bot summary: 

bench-bot: run 1968765432 summary:
```
EMBEDDINGS (1k qps equivalent):
- L4 (fp16): p95=23ms, p99=45ms, throughput=1200 emb/s, cost= $0.28 per 1k
- T4 (4-bit): p95=38ms, p99=85ms, throughput=700 emb/s, cost= $0.14 per 1k
- A10G (fp16 + flash): p95=18ms, p99=35ms, throughput=1600 emb/s, cost= $0.40 per 1k

SMALL-CHAT (latency-sensitive, 64 token avg):
- L4 (fp16): p95=110ms, p99=230ms, rps=150, cost ~= $0.60 per 1k tokens
- T4 (4-bit): p95=160ms, p99=370ms, rps=90, cost ~= $0.25 per 1k tokens
- A10G (fp16 + flash): p95=95ms, p99=200ms, rps=190, cost ~= $0.80 per 1k tokens
```

bench-bot: notes: network hop + region adds ~6-12ms median in ap-south, and tail amplification for chat. cache warm prefix reduces p95 ~20% on chat.

jordan: interesting T4 latency looks worse but cost-per-unit lower for embeddings. any kernel differences causing that?

eva_ml: yeah T4 runs used quantized kernels (INT4 path) which reduce mem but we saw a higher per-token latency due to less optimized attention kernels for that specific model shape. small batch sizes hit kernel dispatch overhead.

kai: did you try increasing batch size for T4 to amortize dispatch? maybe push throughput at cost of latency.

eva_ml: did a quick sweep: T4 batch 8=>p95 embeddings improved 20%, but chat p99 worsened (server-side queues). for latency-SLA customers we don't recommend >4 for chat.

marta: region breakdown? is A10G always best tail?

eva_ml: A10G best tail and highest throughput for both workloads when fp16+flash-attn available. but cost-per-1k higher on A10G in our spot pricing mix. eu-west similar to us-west; ap-south had worse tail especially for chat (cold cache + network).

alex: any perf cliffs with sequence length? we ramped from 32->256 tokens?

eva_ml: yes — embeddings unaffected. chat latency grows ~linear after 128 tokens. p99 on T4 jumps sharply past 160 tokens (kernel fragmentation + increased kv cache misses).

jordan: can we translate to capacity planning? e.g., 200 sustained rps small-chat, 50% cold starts, target p95<200ms. what fleet per region?

eva_ml: quick heuristics:
- US/EU (A10G preferred): 1 A10G per ~180 rps (fp16, warm cache). to maintain p95<200ms with 50% cold, plan 1.6x buffer -> ~1 per 110 rps effective.
- T4 (cost-sensitive): 1 T4 per ~90 rps (4-bit, warm). with buffer ~1 per 55 rps.
- L4 (balanced): 1 L4 per ~150 rps. buffer -> ~1 per 90 rps.

kai: so rough on-demand mix for 200 rps across regions: 2 A10G or 4 T4 or 3 L4 depending on SLA vs cost.

marta: any notes on kernel selection flags we should codify in model profiles?

eva_ml: yes add to model profile: prefer `flash-attn` on A10G if seq_len<=256; prefer `quant-int4-kernel-v2` on T4 for embeddings only; force `batch_limit=4` for chat on T4 to protect latency; enable `kv_warm_prefix=true` for chat routes.

alex: quality regressions? does quant4 change embedding similarity?

eva_ml: small delta: cosine drop ~0.6-0.9% absolute for 4-bit vs fp16 on open-embed-512 — acceptable for search but flag if customer has tight recall. we ran eval set 10k queries.

jordan: any weird outliers in logs? OOMs, kernel fallbacks?

eva_ml: one fallback on T4 when trying flash-attn fallback to fused kernel for chat at seq=512 — logged `kernel_mismatch` and retried with higher mem kernel, added retry latency ~120ms.

marta: action items?

eva_ml:
- add model-profile flags to repo (PR coming)
- add region-specific sizing doc (US/EU/APAC) with numbers above
- run a 24h soak with mixed traffic to validate spot pricing and autoscale triggers
- notify solutions-eng about embedding quality delta for 4-bit

alex: thanks. can you attach the raw bench CSVs? I'll eyeball.

eva_ml: uploading CSVs to drive: https://redwood.ai/bench/pulse-1968765432 (perm: eng-ml)

bench-bot: uploaded artifacts: `1968765432/` (csv, logs, summaries).

kai: thumbs up. let's keep this as the quick reference for sizing PR. :thumbsup:
